name: Bara yori mo Bara no Gotoku
original_name: 薔薇よりも薔薇の如く
source:
Recently I have the same dream.
A black rose and a white rose.
The choking scent carries words of an oath.
I don't know what the dream means.
Knowing nothing, I begin my new school life.
It's here that my dream and reality become inseparable.
It's here I learn the meaning of the Legend of Black Rose. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE090442.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
最近，我总在做同一个梦。
一朵黑蔷薇，一朵白蔷薇。
令人窒息的浓香中，传来誓约的话语。
我不知道这个梦意味着什么。
一无所知的我，就这样开始了新的校园生活。
正是在这里，梦境与现实再也无法分开。
也正是在这里，我得知了“黑蔷薇传说”的含义。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE090442.html]DLsite[/url]]
